brief.audience: a layperson (the /build lay-reader default), in English or Khmer
brief.where: inline on heartbank.org (top of the page, beside the headline) and on demo.heartbank.org/Explainer.html and ExplainerKm.html
brief.mechanism: A parent thanks a child for tidying up with a small coin and a thank-you, travelling straight between them while a shared card records the thanks; the child keeps half and passes half on, and it moves on to someone new, never back.

budget.note: inline SVG + one small script; no video, no image, no font beyond the page's own

doctrine: Nothing is animated as a loss, and the picture carries no meter, progress bar, rank or count of people; no water; the figures are drawn, not real; no model is named. It plays once and rests on its last frame, with a Play-again button, never a loop.

s1.en: A parent thanks a child for tidying up, with a small coin and a thank-you.
s1.km: ឪពុកម្តាយអរគុណកូនដែលរៀបចំសម្អាត ដោយកាក់តូចមួយ និងពាក្យអរគុណ។

s2.en: The thanks is written in a shared record.
s2.km: ការអរគុណត្រូវបានសរសេរក្នុងកំណត់ត្រារួម។

s3.en: The child keeps half and passes half on to a grandparent.
s3.km: កុមារទុកពាក់កណ្តាល ហើយឲ្យពាក់កណ្តាលទៀតបន្តទៅជីដូនជីតា។

s4.en: The thanks moves on to someone new. Thanks keep moving.
s4.km: ការអរគុណបន្តទៅមនុស្សថ្មី។ ការអរគុណបន្តធ្វើដំណើរ។

replay.km: លេងម្តងទៀត

alt.en: A parent, a child, a grandparent and a fourth person: a coin and a heart pass between them while a shared card records the thanks.
alt.km: ឪពុកម្តាយ កុមារ ជីដូនជីតា និងមនុស្សទីបួន៖ កាក់ និងបេះដូងឆ្លងកាត់ពួកគេ ហើយប័ណ្ណរួមកត់ត្រាការអរគុណ។
